text.config.jmws-config.title: JourneyMap Waypoint Syncing (JMWS)
text.config.jmws-config.option.showAlert: If waypoint creation, deletion or other alerts are shown
text.config.jmws-config.option.playEffec: If sound effects (usually from alerts) will play.
text.config.jmws-config.option.colouredT: If text will be coloured (e.g. successful action, failure)
If the client should sync waypoints with the server. Technically, this can be disabled and nothing would change.
text.config.jmws-config.option.syncIndic: Shows '(S)' on the end of a waypoint if it is synced to the server.
text.config.jmws-config.option.clientCon: Frequency of when waypoints are grabbed from the server (in seconds)
How long until the mod determines that the server doesn't have JMWS installed (in seconds)
text.config.jmws-config.option.showShari: Show a shared objects owner name next to the waypoint name, if online.
text.config.jmws-config.option.showGloba: Show a '(G)' next to the name of an object if it's global.
text.config.jmws-config.option.serverCon: How large a sync packet can be. Only editable by server.
If server has waypoint syncing enabled.
if server has group syncing enabled.
text.config.jmws-config.option.serverEna: If remote server has JMWS enabled. Changing this does not effect your game in any way.
text.config.jmws-config.option.serverUpl: If remote server has waypoint syncing enabled. Changing this does not effect your game in any way.
If remote server has group syncing enabled. Changing this does not effect your game in any way.
text.config.jmws-config.option.serverAll: Whether or not you can share waypoints and groups with other players in this server. Changing this does not effect your game in any way.
text.config.jmws-config.option.enableSha: If you allow share requests from other users. If disabled, they will be declined automatically.
